_note: Defaults for every domain's LLM-as-Judge run. Per-domain overrides go in config/judge/<domain>.json and carry ONLY the fields that differ; the `release` and `calibration` blocks merge per key, so overriding one field there keeps the rest of the block.

release._note: Which dataset and Q&A build a run scores. Shaped like config/generation/<domain>/release.json and qa_pairs/generator/<domain>/config.json: profile-keyed path maps with {domain}/{dataset_version}/{qa_version} interpolation. qa_config_path and dataset_release_config_path are READ-ONLY pointers into the other modules.
release._version_note: null = resolve the newest build on disk. Set a string to pin one, e.g. "dataset_version": "dataset-v1.0.0" keeps scoring against that build after v2.0.0 exists — which is how a regression comparison is run without regenerating anything.

calibration._note: §10.2 acceptance protocol. min_anchors and agreement_pct are fixed by the Execution Scope (>=10 anchors per domain, within +-1 on >=90% per dimension) — they live here to be reviewable without reading Python, not because they are ours to tune.
calibration._gate_note: require_calibration=true means an LLM run refuses a domain with no passing marker (§10.2: uncalibrated scores must not enter a scorecard). Turning it off is a deliberate, recorded per-domain decision, not a flag someone remembers to pass. --allow-uncalibrated still exists for smoke tests and labels the run calibrated=false.
